title: Gateway Failover Not Working After Router Reboot
symptoms: Users lose internet access when the primary router reboots
Both routers show as HSRP active
The virtual IP is reachable from one subnet but not the other
rootCause: The HSRP group number was changed on one router during a maintenance window, but not on the other. The two routers are now participating in two different HSRP groups, both claiming to be active for the same virtual IP.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the HSRP state on each router?
steps.hint: Look at the State column - you should see one Active and one Standby per group.

steps.prompt: Which command shows detailed HSRP information including group number and virtual IP?
steps.hint: Compare group numbers and virtual IPs between the two routers.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the HSRP configuration on the interface?
steps.hint: Look for 'standby X ip' and 'standby X priority' lines.
